latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of BYOCB ArbInjectionSkill:

- Scans EVM smart contracts for arbitrary call injection vulnerabilities.
- Monitors multiple blockchains in real-time for new contract deployments.
- Supports on-demand scanning of specific addresses.
- Saves findings with risk verdicts (CRITICAL, HIGH, MEDIUM, LOW/SAFE) and detailed reports.
- Provides guidance for alerting users and avoiding false positives.
- Includes scheduled update recommendations and environment variable support.
